entries.subject: Selected model
entries.finding: [Selected model](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/5924) and [original counted mesh](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/64524/shape.txt) — included unchanged. Resolved-imaging-constrained nonconvex geometry; fine relief is unresolved.

entries.subject: DAMIT documentation
entries.finding: [DAMIT documentation](https://damit.cuni.cz/pages/documentation) — coordinate units, pole, period and diameter semantics. CC BY 4.0.

entries.subject: Vernazza et al. (2021)
entries.finding: [Vernazza et al. (2021)](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/references/view/660) — original model publication record.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — retained for comparison; the selected archive model has a physical size calibration. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 87.47 ± 1.13 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented.

entries.subject: Hanuš et al. 2017
entries.finding: [Hanuš et al. 2017](https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.01996), [Viikinkoski et al. 2017](https://arxiv.org/abs/1708.05191), and [Vernazza et al. (2021), VLT/SPHERE imaging survey of the largest main-belt asteroids: Final results and synthesis](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...654A..56V) — resolved-model releases surveyed; when present in this target’s archive they are preferred over an older convex model. Their disk images constrain geometry but are not registered global reflectance mosaics.

entries.subject: Hanuš et al. 2018
entries.finding: [Hanuš et al. 2018](https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.06116) and [occultation dimensions](https://www.asteroidoccultation.com/observations/Asteroid_Dimensions_from_Occultations.html) — size comparison candidates; an independent fit or occultation ellipsoid is not silently equated with this mesh’s volume.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The release supplies no registered surface imagery; the grid marks that gap.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.
